ana: Quick heads-up — Novex onboarding: during 09:00-11:00 UTC we saw ~30% tail latency spikes on their v1-small model (p95 -> p99 diverge). Thinking we should try int8 quant on a canary and route 20% of traffic to compact-llama2-lite as a fallback. Can we schedule a coordinated canary next Tue? :mag_right:

devon: can you paste the p95/p99 numbers and sample trace? also what's current qps baseline?

sanjay: int8 should cut token time ~35% but expect some nuance on tokenization/exactness. We'll want A/B eval against their golden prompt set. canary + metric gates: p99 < 2x baseline, perplexity delta < 1.5%

priya: Novex finance asked about cost impact — will switching change their unit costs significantly? need to loop customer into canary consent.

ana: numbers — p95 220ms, p99 1.1s, baseline qps 85. attaching short trace: ```trace: req 78a2 -> kvcache miss at step 3 -> spike during longer context``` Also draft rollout plan: 1) setup quantized variant on staging, 2) canary 5% -> 20% over 30m, 3) run eval set for regen quality, 4) monitor p95/p99, cost/tokens, user error rate; rollback if p99 > 1.5s or regen fail rate +2%

devon: sounds good. I can handle routing policy in console. I'll create canary route config: ```routes.create({customer:'novex',weights:{v1:80,compact-lite:20},monitor:true})```

sanjay: I'll prepare eval harness and sample prompts. suggest using prompt-based BLEU/ROUGE + human spot-check for 200 hits.

deploy-bot: canary scheduled by devops for 2026-03-28 14:00 UTC — job #rwd-canary-9982

priya: I'll email Novex PM with scope and opt-in. Also capture as renewal positive signal if metrics improve. meeting Friday to sync.

ana: perfect — action items in #cs-runbook. tagging @devon @sanjay for follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
